# watchpoint_auth_profile (Data Source)

Looks up a single auth profile by name within the tenant. Exposes credential metadata only; the encrypted client secret, password, refresh token, static key and client certificate / private key are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_auth_profile" "example" {
  name = "PaymentsApi"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the auth profile to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `id` (String) Auth profile ID.
- `kind` (String) Credential kind (e.g. `OAuth2ClientCredentials`, `StaticApiKey`, `Mtls`).
- `token_prefix` (String) Prefix prepended to the token when injected into requests.
